Now I understand the CoAP header format:
- Byte 0: Version (2 bits), Type (2 bits), Token Length (4 bits)
- Byte 1: Code
- Bytes 2-3: Message ID (big-endian)
- Token (variable length, 0-8 bytes)
- Options (variable length)
- Payload marker (0xFF) followed by payload
